# ModelCall

`schemas/records/model-call.json`

A model call's durable binding (docs/design/m1/00-slice-plan.md P12a; 03 "External effects"; 05 "Usage and settlement"): the call to its attempt, the attempt's lease, and the resource groups that lease reserves on. It is the request of the call's model_call effect, and the payload of the model_call.intended event that commits with that intent, before the gateway sends anything for the call. A call is bound once: its binding never changes. Recovery reads it to keep an uncertain call's charge on its groups.

## Fields of the document

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `call` | yes | [CallID](common-defs.md#callid) | The call-ledger id; its model_call effect has the same suffix under eff_. |
| `attempt` | yes | [AttemptID](common-defs.md#attemptid) | The attempt the call is made for, the one its lease is running. |
| `lease` | yes | [LeaseID](common-defs.md#leaseid) |  |
| `executor` | yes | [ExecutorID](common-defs.md#executorid) | The lease's executor. |
| `destination` | yes | [Slug](config-project-profile.md#slug) | The registry's destination for that executor; also the intent's target. |
| `groups` | yes | array of [ResourceGroupID](common-defs.md#resourcegroupid) (unique items) | The groups of the lease's reservations, sorted: where the call's usage, or its liability, is charged. |

No other fields are allowed.
